title: Nestor Guide
subtitle: Logistics Battleship
body:
# Nestor

---

The Nestor is the primary logistics ship in armor fleets. It provides remote armor repairs and cap transfers to keep the fleet alive.

## Key Points

- Watch broadcasts constantly and respond immediately to armor repair requests.
- If there are both Shield and Armor split reps as needed.
- You should be stable with at least 5 reps and your MWD running.
- You have an MJD fit, this should only be used if the FC tells you to use it.
- Pre-lock likely aggro targets (meatshield, nestors, LR's in tcrc's).
- Ideally you shouldn't get initial aggros, but 
- Do everything the FC specifically tells you to do.

## Positioning 

TPPH- Room 1 and 2 burn to the out gate. Room 3 burn up and left of the tower you should end up being near the top of the tower on the opposite side as the meatshield.

NRF- Burn 70KM straight forward. May need to burn back towards the beacon if the FC tells you to. ONLY IF THE FC TELLS YOU TO. FC may also tell you to MJD to the beacon. ONLY DO SO IF YOU ARE TOLD.

TCRC- Burn to the left side of the tower.

##Aggro Flow

TPPH- Room 1 and 2 aggro is dictated (mostly) by who breaks invulnerability first. Aggro may split between 2 targets, keep an eye out for this and split reps as needed. Room 3 initial aggro will be dictated as before. Split reps as needed and watch for early jumps (suicide jumps). After that aggro SHOULD go to the meatshield and nestors for the remainder of the site, however if someone is aggressing frigates during wave 2 or more likely wave 3 spawn then they will get aggro. Watch out for this, especially on vindi's.

NRF-Initial aggro is dictated (mostly) by who breaks invulnerability first. Aggro may split between two targets. Split reps as needed and watch for early jumps (suicide jumps). After that aggro SHOULD go to the meatshield and nestors for the remainder of the site, it may go to a marauder on 4th wave though. 

TCRC- Initial aggro should go to the meatshield, if you are quick on entering you can usually get a cycle of reps on them before they jump backwards. After that aggro should bounce back and forth between the LR's but keep an eye for aggro to either split or go to a non-LR marauder. There is also a group of cruisers/frigates called "Troll" aggro which may require 1-2 reps from you, especially if it's a shield maurader. 

## Heating Reps 

Heat reps when required. FC should tell you when it's needed, but use your brain. ALWAYS REPAIR THEM AFTER HEATING WHEN YOU ARE CERTAIN THERE WILL NOT BE AN ISSUE.
